intro: This backend signs in through {wirecloud} ({url}). Signing in happens in the browser, and you create a new account there too. This program never sees your password.
waiting: Waiting for the sign-in in the browser …
waitingHint: The browser has opened. Sign in there and give your consent; then it continues here. Nothing happens? Then the sign-in is still open there.
linkIntro: This backend already has an account for {email} from the time before WireCloud. Enter its previous {password} to link it with your WireCloud account. Your data and keys are kept.
previousPasswordHint: The password you have used to sign in here so far. The master password is a different one and is not asked for.
